name: Protein Pocket 3D Generative Benchmark
description: Evaluates pocket-based 3D molecular generative models on their ability to generate physically plausible and functionally relevant ligand-pocket complexes.
general_score_metric: RMSD / docking_score (reported as a composite or multi-metric score combining geometric fit and predicted binding quality)
reputation: A specialized benchmark used in the computational chemistry and structure‑based generative modeling community; recognized but not yet as widely adopted as ligand‑only generative benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; evaluation depends on docking/scoring approximations and simulation biases; potential contamination from public structural databases (PDB); metric heterogeneity across works can complicate comparisons.
